feature.summary: Keeps older versions of files (project knowledge files, published artifacts, and, in code only, generated files) and lets the owner of a project share it with their organisation as read-only or with named editors. Web and mobile have a sharing screen; versions have no per-file history screen found for files.

purpose.what_it_does: Two linked jobs. First, versioning: a re-uploaded project file with the same name becomes a new version and the old one is marked superseded (apps/web/lib/server/project-knowledge-files.ts:394, :425); a published artifact keeps an append-only history that can be listed, read and restored (apps/web/lib/services/published-artifact-service.ts:871, :971, :500; apps/web/app/api/artifacts/publish/[token]/versions/route.ts:34); a generated file can point at the file it replaced and at the file it was made from (apps/web/lib/server/generated-file-persist.ts:95, :56). Second, sharing: a project owner or sharing manager shares a project with the organisation and sets per-person access (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:305, :405).
purpose.why_it_exists: Migration 0257 says a file had no history and no parent, a republish overwrote the earlier version, and nobody could answer where an export came from (apps/web/db/neon/0257_file_versions_and_lineage.sql:2-20). Sharing exists so a team can work from one project's instructions and files while chats stay private (apps/web/features/settings/sections/OrganizationSharingSection.tsx:196).
purpose.who_uses_it: Project owners, organisation owners and admins, members with the share right, invited editors, and anyone who republishes an artifact. [inferred] from the permission checks (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:91).
problems_solved: A newer upload of a same-named project file no longer destroys the old row; it is superseded, not deleted (apps/web/lib/resources/deletion-policies.ts:197-218).
Raising a project's default access can never silently give the whole organisation edit rights; edit is a per-member grant (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:213-217).
A member later moved to Viewer cannot keep using an old edit grant, because the right is checked again on every read (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:264-266).
A health space cannot be shared (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:361).
use_cases: Owner shares a research project with the workspace so every member can read its files.
Owner shares a project 'with people I choose' and grants two colleagues Can edit.
User re-uploads a corrected spec with the same file name; the project uses the new one and the old is kept as a superseded version.
User restores an earlier published version of an artifact.

surface:desktop: no sharing control found in apps/desktop/src (searched for the route; none). Not available in code found.
surface:cli, surface:vscode, surface:chrome: no use of the sharing route found in apps/cli; apps/vscode and apps/chrome folders were not found at those paths, so unknown.
Version history of a published artifact: API only is confirmed (GET /api/artifacts/publish/[token]/versions); the screen that calls it was not located.

Role right 'sharing.manage', or right 'content.share' and ownership of the project (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:91-118).
A plan whose project limit is not 0 (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:310).

Personal accounts see a note on how to get an organisation instead of an error (apps/web/features/settings/sections/OrganizationSharingSection.test.tsx test 'tells a personal account how to get an organization').
screens_and_controls: Project picker 'Select one of your projects…' (label 'Project to share'), audience picker (label 'Who can open it'), button 'Share project with organization' / 'Sharing…' (OrganizationSharingSection.tsx:209-241).
Shared list rows show 'Visible to N of M members' and 'read-only' or 'N can edit', plus an unshare control for those who may manage the project (OrganizationSharingSection.tsx:260-300).
Empty state text 'Nothing is shared yet.' (OrganizationSharingSection.tsx:247).
journey: Pick one of your projects not already shared.
Choose who can open it: the workspace (default access read) or only invited people (default access none) (apps/web/app/api/settings/organization/shared/projects/[projectId]/route.ts:83).
Press 'Share project with organization'; the client sends PUT to the project route.
Optionally set a person to read, write, none or inherit (PATCH).
feedback_and_outputs: Toast 'Project shared with your workspace' or 'Project shared with the people you invite' (apps/web/features/settings/hooks/use-settings-queries.ts:1765-1769).
Toast 'Access updated' and 'Project is no longer shared' (use-settings-queries.ts:1787, :1813).
Errors show a toast with a user-safe message, for example 'Only the project's owner or someone who manages sharing can change who can open it.' (org-sharing-service.ts:113-117).
An audit event is recorded: project_shared, project_member_access_changed, project_unshared (route.ts:89, route.ts:114, route.ts:196).
settings: Organisation roles and permissions decide who may share (SYS-authorization-and-workspaces).
Plan project limit (sharedProjectLimit) decides how many projects may be shared (apps/web/lib/services/org-entitlements.ts:128).

working: Share, per-member access and unshare routes exist with CSRF, rate limit, validation and audit (apps/web/app/api/settings/organization/shared/projects/[projectId]/route.ts:216-218).
Sharing quota is enforced inside the same SQL statement via assert_org_resource_limit (apps/web/lib/services/org-sharing-service.ts:305-345).
Edit grant is checked against the current role on every read (org-sharing-service.ts:264, :276).

Project knowledge file versions: version = max+1, supersedes_id set, older row marked superseded_at, under an advisory lock per project and file name (apps/web/lib/server/project-knowledge-files.ts:389-430).

Published artifact version list, read and restore routes (apps/web/app/api/artifacts/publish/[token]/versions/route.ts:34; apps/web/app/api/artifacts/publish/[token]/versions/[version]/route.ts:46, :133).
Library helper groups files into newest version plus older ones and walks lineage (packages/platform/files/src/library.ts:20-128).
incomplete: Generated-file revisions: persistGeneratedFileBytes accepts supersedesFileId and parentFileId (apps/web/lib/server/generated-file-persist.ts:296-316), but no production caller was found that passes a provenance object; only the function definition and tests mention it. So media_assets rows get version 1 in practice [inferred from a code search of apps/web].

Migration 0257 file header says 'NOT YET APPLIED : draft only' (apps/web/db/neon/0257_file_versions_and_lineage.sql:4). Whether it is applied is not recorded in the files read; the product memory notes a later migration number in production, so the header is probably stale [inferred].

No restore route for an older project knowledge file version or an older generated file version was found (only DELETE and GET on the file route: apps/web/app/api/projects/[id]/knowledge-files/[fileId]/route.ts:96-97).
disconnected_or_disabled: file_lineage is written only when a caller passes parentFileId; no such caller found, so the lineage table is likely empty in practice [inferred].
not_available: surface:desktop: no project sharing screen found.
surface:cli: no sharing or version call found.
surface:vscode and surface:chrome: not searched under confirmed paths (apps/vscode and apps/chrome do not exist); unknown.
Folder hierarchy and external references are out of this feature (brief S95.17, S95.18 marked platform missing).

established.statement: File versions are kept (supersede chain, published versions, lineage).
Files and file-bearing resources can be shared (org sharing, publish links) under access control.
Sharing checks the organisation permission before a write.
Shared projects: members with access read instructions and files; Can edit lets them change it; chats stay private.

acceptance_criteria: Re-uploading a same-named file to a project makes the newest row version N+1, the previous row has superseded_at set, and the file list shows only the newest.
Sharing a project as a member without sharing.manage who does not own it returns 403 'Only the project's owner or someone who manages sharing...'.
Sharing with audience 'invited' sets default access none; 'workspace' sets read.
Granting write to a Viewer-role member is refused with the Viewer message.
A plan with project limit 0 refuses sharing with a validation error; at the limit, sharing returns a conflict.
Unsharing a project that is not shared returns 404 'That project is not shared with your organization'.
Each share, access change and unshare writes an audit event.
Republishing an artifact adds a version row and restore creates a new version rather than editing history.
inferred: Generated files should get versions when the model edits an earlier file, which needs callers to pass supersedesFileId [inferred from the unused parameter].
Shared project file access should also hide files of a deleted or archived project (see archived retrieval rules, apps/web/db/neon/0244_archived_resources_leave_ai_retrieval.sql) [inferred].
proposed: [proposed] Pass supersedesFileId and parentFileId from the tool loop and sandbox file sweep so edits and exports record versions and lineage.
[proposed] Add a per-file version history screen and restore route for project knowledge files and generated files.
[proposed] Correct or remove the 'NOT YET APPLIED' header in migration 0257 once its state is confirmed.

steps.what_happens: Person presses share in the Sharing page; the browser sends PUT with the audience.
Server checks rate limit and CSRF, resolves membership, and requires sharing.manage or content.share plus ownership.
shareProject reads the plan limit, then one SQL statement checks ownership, upserts the share row and asserts the quota.
Audit event is recorded and the shared project summary returned.
Later reads include shared projects the member can read; write is allowed only for owner or a current-role-valid write grant.
Version flow: a new project file registration locks per project and name, inserts version max+1 and marks the older row superseded.

data.retained_or_deleted: Removed on unshare; not otherwise covered in the files read (unknown for project purge).

data.what: File version fields and superseded marker
data.retained_or_deleted: Superseded is not deleted: only deleted_at starts the 30-day window (apps/web/lib/resources/deletion-policies.ts:216-217).
Deleted when either file is purged (deletion-policies.ts:246-251).
No update policy; deleted with owner rows (0257 migration policies).

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: No model or provider takes part in sharing or versioning itself. Generated-file versions are produced by tool output from a chat turn, so the model decides when a file is generated; the sandbox provider is recorded as the provider field on the file (apps/web/lib/server/generated-file-persist.ts:217-260).

access_and_usage.account: Signed-in account and active organisation membership required for sharing (org-sharing-service.ts:120-125). Versions need a signed-in owner.
access_and_usage.permissions: sharing.manage, or content.share plus project ownership. Edit grants need content.share held by the target (org-sharing-service.ts:91-118, :264, :405).
access_and_usage.subscription: Plan project limit via sharedProjectLimit; 0 blocks sharing (org-sharing-service.ts:310; org-entitlements.ts:128). The exact numbers per plan were not read (unknown).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Shared project count limited by plan; rate limit key 'settings-org-patch' (route.ts:47). Storage metering of versions: superseded rows are excluded from the project file list (knowledge-files route list query) [inferred], storage meter rules not read in full.
access_and_usage.flags: none found in the code for sharing; the routes read no feature flag.
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: none found in the code; independent of model.
access_and_usage.local_mode: Sharing and server versions need the Cloud service and an organisation; mode:local has no sharing rule in the code read. Local desktop files and versions: unknown (not searched).

scenarios.name: Share to workspace
steps: Sign in as a member with content.share who owns a project.
Open Sharing, pick the project, choose the workspace audience, press Share.
Sign in as another member and open the project.
scenarios.expected: The second member can read the project and its files but not edit; an audit row project_shared exists.

scenarios.name: Invited only and Can edit
steps: Grant write to a Member and to a Viewer.
scenarios.expected: Member is granted; Viewer grant is refused with the role message.

scenarios.name: Role downgrade
steps: They try to save the project.
scenarios.expected: Write is refused because the right is re-checked on read.

scenarios.name: Plan limit
steps: Use a plan at its shared-project limit.
scenarios.expected: Conflict message about the limit; nothing shared.

scenarios.name: File version supersede
steps: Upload a.pdf to a project, then upload a different a.pdf.
scenarios.expected: List shows one a.pdf; the old row has superseded_at and the new has version 2.

scenarios.name: Artifact restore
steps: Publish an artifact, change it, republish, then restore version 1 through the versions route.
scenarios.expected: A new latest version holds version 1's content; history keeps all rows.

corrections.claim: Subscription: Plan project limit via sharedProjectLimit; 0 blocks sharing (org-entitlements.ts:128)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: sharedProjectLimit is the plan's general 'projects' limit (limits?.projects) run through toEnforceableBillingPlanLimit, not a dedicated sharing limit. 'unlimited' and 'custom' become null (no cap). The page says the numbers were not read, but they are in the catalog: Free is 5, paid and max plans are 'unlimited'.
corrections.correction: The shared-project cap reuses the plan's projects limit (Free 5, most paid plans unlimited, one plan custom); a limit of 0 (or non-numeric undefined) blocks sharing.

corrections.claim: surface:vscode and surface:chrome: apps/vscode and apps/chrome do not exist; unknown
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The paths are indeed absent, but the real folders are apps/extension (Chrome) and apps/extension-vscode. The page never searched them. A grep of apps/extension/src, apps/extension-vscode/src, apps/cli and apps/desktop/src for 'organization/shared' found no sharing-route call.
corrections.evidence: ls apps -> cli, desktop, extension, extension-vscode, mobile, web
corrections.correction: Chrome is apps/extension and VS Code is apps/extension-vscode. Neither calls the organization shared-projects route (searched). They are not 'unknown' for sharing.

corrections.claim: Deletion: Superseded is not deleted: only deleted_at starts the 30-day window (deletion-policies.ts:216-217); lineage deleted when either file is purged (:246-251)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The 'only deleted_at starts the window' text is at the cited place. The window length comes from RESOURCE_RECOVERY_WINDOW_DAYS, not a literal 30 in these lines, so 30 days is not shown at these lines. The lineage deletion matches (columns child_file_id and parent_file_id). The supersedes_id child rule is 'detach', which the page omits.
corrections.correction: Say 'the recovery window (RESOURCE_RECOVERY_WINDOW_DAYS)' unless the constant is verified as 30. Purging an old version detaches supersedes_id on the newer row; it does not delete the newer row.

missing_facts: The shared-project cap is the plan's general projects limit (Free 5, most paid plans unlimited, one plan custom), so most paid orgs have no sharing limit. packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:618,563,584,714,787-790; apps/web/lib/services/org-entitlements.ts:128.
Chrome and VS Code live in apps/extension and apps/extension-vscode; the page searched non-existent paths and left them unknown. Neither calls the sharing route.
The published-artifact versions GET and the restore POST are scoped to userId (owner only) via getUserScopedDb. apps/web/app/api/artifacts/publish/[token]/versions/[version]/route.ts:38,64-71.
